source: 2026-07-04 local source-tree production CLI probes against docwen-ref-tk, docwen-ref-pyside6, and docwen-current
probe_scope: True CLI entrypoint smoke with real DOCX->Markdown and PNG->Markdown conversions plus one unsupported notes.bad input; no external Office dependency.

notes.bad.expected_current_behavior: prevalidation invalid_input failure is included in JSON batch results but is not sent to runtime
notes.bad.old_system_production_behavior: old source-tree CLIs sniff the text content as markdown and then fail the markdown->md strategy route

docwen-ref-tk.command_shape: uv run docwen convert --to md --batch --json --continue-on-error image_mix.docx image_mix.png notes.bad
docwen-ref-tk.stdout_json_prefix_noise: config-manager debug lines can precede the JSON object

docwen-ref-pyside6.command_shape: uv run docwen convert --to md --batch --json --continue-on-error image_mix.docx image_mix.png notes.bad

docwen-current.command_shape: uv run docwen run --to md --batch --json --continue-on-error image_mix.docx image_mix.png notes.bad
docwen-current.output_path_style: stable files beside inputs, e.g. image_mix.md and image_mix_001.md
docwen-current.invalid_failure_stage: CLI prevalidation; invalid file is not sent to runtime

focused_scope_decision: For this DOCX/PNG/bad focused smoke, the old=3/current=2 process exit-code difference is accepted as the same stage-specific architecture difference recorded by the DOCX/XLSX/bad smoke: the user-visible batch projection remains aligned, while current keeps the earlier invalid_input prevalidation boundary.
comparison_implication: This broadens GOLDEN-006 beyond the DOCX/XLSX/bad case with an image route that all three projects can convert without external Office. It also records the CLI OCR boundary: without --ocr, image->Markdown should preserve the image link and should not inherit image route OCR defaults. Broader CLI artifact matrices still remain open.
